description: This file contains unit tests for focus mapping logic in an Android TV UI component, specifically testing index calculations for focus movement when navigating upward between rows. The tests validate boundary conditions, boundary clamping, and behavior with empty rows.

classes.name: FocusMappingTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests to validate the behavior of computeTargetIndex for focus navigation in a UI grid layout.

methods.name: computeTargetIndex
methods.description: A helper function that calculates the target focus index in an upper row when navigating upward, applying clamping or returning -1 if the upper row is empty.

methods.name: 2nd row to 1st row maps within bounds
methods.description: Tests that the index mapping stays within valid bounds without requiring clamping.

methods.name: 2nd row to 1st row clamps when index exceeds
methods.description: Tests that the function correctly clamps indices exceeding the upper row's size.

methods.name: upper row empty returns -1
methods.description: Tests that the function returns -1 when the upper row has zero items.

methods.name: negative current index coerces to zero
methods.description: Tests that negative current indices are coerced to zero.

methods.name: 3rd row to 2nd row general mapping
methods.description: Validates index mapping with larger upper rows and boundary clamping.

methods.name: 4th row to 3rd row general mapping
methods.description: Further boundary condition testing for higher row indices.
